title: Actual affine finite-free resolution of a quasi-coherent complex
statement: Let U be an affine open subscheme of a scheme T [def-pc-scheme], C a complex of quasi-coherent O_U-modules [def-pc-derived-category], and d a natural number. Suppose C vanishes termwise above d and its complex of global sections is pseudo-coherent [def-pc-ring-pseudo-coherent-complex]. Then there exists a complex Q of O_U-modules vanishing above d, each of whose terms is finite free [def-weil-pbc-free-module], and an actual quasi-isomorphism Q→C. No geometric morphism, nonnegative bound, or flatness hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Evaluate C at the top open. The additive evaluation functor sends zero terms to zero terms, so its module complex D is strictly bounded above by d; transport its homology vanishing through homologyFunctorFactors. Apply exists_finiteFree_model_isStrictlyLE to Q(D) and its pseudo-coherence hypothesis to obtain P with finite free terms, upper bound d and a derived isomorphism Q(P) ≅ Q(D).

Free modules are projective. Apply CochainComplex.isKProjective_of_projective at d. Surjectivity of IsKProjective.Qh_map_bijective lifts the derived isomorphism after conjugating by quotientCompQhIso. Fullness of HomotopyCategory.quotient supplies an actual chain map f:P→D. Naturality and cancellation show Q.map f equals the isomorphism hom; isIso_Q_map_iff_quasiIso therefore proves QuasiIso f.

Apply exists_affine_sheaf_resolution_of_ring_model to U, C, P and the actual quasi-isomorphism f. This provides Q, the same termwise upper bound, finite free sheaf terms and the required actual quasi-isomorphism Q→C.

lean.statement: theorem exists_proper_cohomology_finite_free_resolution {T : Scheme.{u}} (U : T.Opens) [IsAffine U.toScheme] (C : CochainComplex U.toScheme.Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ) (hCle : C.IsStrictlyLE d) (hCqc : ∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsQuasicoherent) (hpc : (letI : CommRing (U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (.op ⊤)) := inferInstanceAs (CommRing Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)); letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (.op ⊤))); DerivedCategory.IsPseudoCoherent (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (((SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf (.op ⊤)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj C)))) : ∃ Q : CochainComplex U.toScheme.Modules ℤ, Q.IsStrictlyLE d ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (Q.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))) ∧ ∃ e : Q ⟶ C, QuasiIso e
